bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $360，SAR 转为看空

read.en: Tesla fell 7.6% on Nov 20 to $345.82, its lowest close since Nov 5, trading $344.33–373.88. It is below the 5-day ($372.8), 10-day ($380.0), 30-day ($380.3), 100-day ($365.1) and 200-day ($381.7), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5 and has dropped below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Nov 20 ($404.40), and RSI is 37.8, down from 53.5 five sessions ago.
read.zh: 特斯拉 11月20日下跌 7.6%，收于 $345.82，为 11月5日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $344.33–373.88。股价位于 5 日（$372.8）、10 日（$380.0）、30 日（$380.3）、100 日（$365.1）和 200 日均线（$381.7）下方，均在下行。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，现已跌至零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 于 11月20日转为看空（$404.40），RSI 为 37.8，五个交易日前为 53.5。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports, $370.4–370.8, $365.3–365.9 (100-day, Oct 23 low) and $360, now resistance; the $388 cap stays well overhead. Resistance is $345.9–354 (September, October and March lows), then $360–365.9 and $370.4–374 (5-day, Nov 20 high). Support is $338–344.3 (Nov 5 low and close, Aug 26 low), then $331.4–337.2 and $326.6. A close above $354 would target $360–366; below $338, $331–337.

r.en: Nov 9 low $360.02; 100-day average $365.1; Oct 23 low $365.27, lost

s.en: Nov 20 low $344.33; Nov 5 close $343.69; Aug 26 low $342.53; Nov 5 low $338.15
